description: This PHP class defines the 'OAuthAuthorizationCode' entity used in an OAuth2 authorization flow, mapping to the 'ohrm_oauth2_authorization_code' database table. It includes properties for authorization code details such as ID, code, client ID, user ID, redirect URI, expiry time, and revocation status, along with getter and setter methods for each property.

classes.name: OAuthAuthorizationCode
classes.description: Entity class representing OAuth2 authorization codes, with properties mapping to database columns and methods to access and modify these properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the authorization code record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the authorization code record.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID associated with this authorization code.

methods.name: setClientId
methods.description: Sets the client ID associated with this authorization code.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with this authorization code.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID associated with this authorization code.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Retrieves the redirect URI linked to this authorization code.

methods.name: setRedirectUri
methods.description: Sets the redirect URI for this authorization code.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiration DateTimeImmutable object in UTC timezone.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiration DateTimeImmutable object for this authorization code.

methods.name: isRevoked
methods.description: Checks if the authorization code has been revoked.

methods.name: setRevoked
methods.description: Sets the revoked status of the authorization code.
